title: WOD-E2E: Waymo Open Dataset for End-to-End Driving in Challenging Long-tail Scenarios
reasoning: The paper focuses on the release and benchmarking of an autonomous driving dataset (WOD-E2E) and a new evaluation metric (RFS). While it incorporates 'safety' and 'legality' as dimensions for human raters to score trajectories, these are treated as technical and regulatory performance metrics for driving rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of ethics, morals, or religion.
